query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple latest iPhone buy official US iPhone 2026
queries: Apple latest iPhone buy official US iPhone 2026

content.text:
You can buy the latest iPhone directly from **Apple’s official iPhone store** online or in an Apple Store. As of the latest Apple Store listing I found, Apple is selling the **iPhone 17 Pro / iPhone 17 Pro Max** starting from **$1,099**. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_iphone?utm_source=openai))

Other good places to buy in the U.S.:

- **Apple Store** — best for unlocked phones, trade-in, AppleCare+, carrier activation.
- **Carrier stores** — Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile; often best if you want installment promos or trade-in deals.
- **Major retailers** — Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Target; availability and deals vary.
- **Refurbished/pre-owned** — Apple Certified Refurbished, Best Buy, Back Market, or carrier certified pre-owned if you want to save money.

If you want the safest/easiest option: **buy from Apple directly**, especially if you want an unlocked iPhone.
